about: A ready call for each tool's card (tool_find { tool }): its arguments filled from the open document (=facts.… as in nexthint.json) and the values the agent must give marked. fill: each value to give (keep: true, a worked value to change; unless: an expression that, when it has a value, fills it). Owner, 22 Nov.

pd_body_new.source: the tool's card and schema (tools.json); worked values written for this file

fill.what: XY, XZ, YZ; or, in place of plane, face: { side: "+z" } or { at, normal }

sketch_new.source: the tool's card and schema (tools.json); worked values written for this file

fill.what: your geometry, in the sketch's x/y, mm. These four items are a link with two round ends (ids 0 to 3). Arc 0 has radius 10 at x 0, arc 1 radius 6 at x 80, and two lines join them. Use arcs, not full circles, for round ends. Then sketch_constrain tangent on the two end points at each joint: [[2, 1], [0, 2]], [[2, 2], [1, 1]], [[1, 2], [3, 1]], [[3, 2], [0, 1]]. A plate on XY is centred: rectangle { center: [0, 0], size: [w, h] }. A shape at an edge of the body takes corner [x min, y min] from sketch_new's bodyExtent

fill.what: your constraints: a ref is a geometry id g, or a point [g, vertex] (vertex 1 start, 2 end, 3 centre); these four join line 0's end to line 1's start, make line 0 horizontal and 40 mm long, and fix its start
